strictLocalMode.title: Enforce Strict Local Mode (Zero Network Lookups)
strictLocalMode.description: When true, disables all off-device RDAP, DNS, and URIBL domain lookups so zero network requests leave the browser (recommended for HIPAA-regulated environments).

disableLocalReports.title: Disable Local False-Positive Reports
disableLocalReports.description: When true, prevents saving redacted false-positive notes in local browser storage.
